title: Imiphefumulo Yomsele
intro: Ubuyela enkathini lapho umbusi ononya wayefuna ukuzinikela okuphelele konkulunkulu bamanga. Umphakathi omncane wemiphefumulo ezinikele wenqaba, futhi wabhekana nesijeziso esinzima kangangokuthi waba yisiqalekiso saphakade. Indaba yabo izwakala kulo lonke iQuran njengobufakazi bokholo olungantengantengi. Ungalibona leli qembu eliqinile?
clues: Sasihlala ezweni elingaphansi kobushiqela bombusi owayefuna ukukhulekelwa konkulunkulu bamanga
Umphakathi wethu wabhekana nokushushiswa okunzima ngenxa yokukholelwa kwethu ku-Allah kuphela
Umbusi wayala ukuba kumbiwe umsele omkhulu bese kushiswa ngamalangabi avuthayo
Ngenxa yokuthi senqaba ukulahla ukholo lwethu, saphonswa kulowo mgodi ovuthayo ngamunye ngamunye
Indaba yethu yaba yingxenye yeQuran, futhi labo ababesishushisa baqalekiswa phakade.
I-surah eqopha usizi lwethu iqanjwe ngezibonakaliso ezinkulu zesibhakabhaka

outcome.label: Umphumela Wethu
options: Sabulawa ukholo futhi abashushisi baqalekiswa phakade
Saguqulwa saba yizinkawu ngenxa yokuphambuka kwethu
Ukukhala okukodwa okubhubhisayo kwaphazamisa ukuphila kwethu
outcome.answer: Sabulawa ukholo futhi abashushisi baqalekiswa phakade

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
